reconciliation: Every implemented command has a feature-guide reference; those guides define command purpose and semantic constraints.
Parameter fields record the installed Typer/Click parser surface, including aliases, defaults, required state, and numeric bounds.
Parser types remain distinct from application-level validation; for example report target-kind and format values are validated by the report command while their parser type is str.
Global --project and --json options are documented separately in guide/cli-reference.md and are not repeated as leaf parameters.
All observed options are public help entries; hidden is explicitly false for every committed leaf parameter.
The root callback adds --project and --json plus the eager --version flag; their parser metadata is recorded separately from leaf commands.
Typer injects --install-completion and --show-completion on the root command; they are recorded as framework-provided global flags and remain enabled.
Terminal-first amendment removes demo --open and serve --no-open; all other parser parameters are preserved and verified against actual Typer metadata.
Agent-workflow amendment adds capabilities; its catalog and command parameters are derived at runtime from the installed CLI parser, with no project or credential access.
Managed-image import adds an explicit absolute --asset-root for local image reads during preview and commit; image bytes stay outside selected text/JSON.
